# Discord
> Discord is a communication platform for group chat, voice, video, communities, and developer integrations.

Discord supports social groups, gaming communities, creators, and developers with apps, APIs, safety resources, support content, and advertising products.

## Core Platform
- [Discord Home](https://discord.gg/): Main entry point for Discord’s chat, voice, and community platform.
- [Download Discord](https://discord.com/download): Download Discord desktop and mobile apps for supported platforms.
- [Nitro](https://discord.com/nitro): Overview of Discord’s premium subscription features and perks.
- [Servers](https://discord.com/servers): Discover public communities and server-based experiences on Discord.
- [Blog](https://discord.com/blog): Official announcements, product updates, and community stories from Discord.
- [Careers](https://discord.com/careers): Open roles, company information, and hiring resources at Discord.

## Developer Platform
- [Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers): Central hub for building apps, bots, and integrations for Discord.
- [Developer Documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs): Technical documentation for Discord APIs, gateway, and application features.
- [API Reference](https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference): Core API concepts, authentication, versioning, and request conventions.
- [Applications](https://discord.com/developers/applications): Manage Discord applications, bots, OAuth2 settings, and configuration.
- [OAuth2](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/oauth2): Authorization flows and scopes for integrating with Discord accounts and servers.
- [Gateway](https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/gateway): Real-time event connection model for bots and applications.
- [Interactions](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/overview): Slash commands, components, modals, and interaction-based app experiences.
- [SDKs and Tools](https://discord.com/developers/docs/discord-social-sdk): Documentation for Discord SDK capabilities and integration tooling.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://support.discord.com/hc): Official support portal for Discord products, accounts, and troubleshooting.
- [Community Feedback](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/community/topics): User feedback boards and product discussion topics.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact Discord support for account, billing, or technical issues.
- [Safety Center](https://discord.com/safety): Central safety information, policies, and family resources.
- [Status](https://discordstatus.com/): Service status, incident history, and uptime information for Discord systems.

## Safety Resources
- [Family Center](https://discord.com/safety-family-center): Tools and guidance for families using Discord safely.
- [Safety Library](https://discord.com/safety-library): Collection of educational safety articles, explainers, and best practices.
- [Safety News](https://discord.com/safety-news): Updates and announcements related to Discord safety initiatives.
- [Teen Charter](https://discord.com/safety-teen-charter): Safety principles and expectations designed for teen users.
- [Parent Hub](https://discord.com/safety-parents): Guidance for parents supporting teens on Discord.
- [Policy Hub](https://discord.com/safety-policies): Access point for Discord’s safety and platform policy materials.
- [Privacy Hub](https://discord.com/safety-privacy): Privacy-focused guidance, controls, and educational resources.
- [Transparency Hub](https://discord.com/safety-transparency): Information about enforcement, reporting, and transparency efforts.
- [Wellbeing Hub](https://discord.com/safety-wellbeing): Resources focused on healthy online habits and digital wellbeing.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms): Terms governing use of Discord’s services and platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://discord.com/privacy): Details on data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [Community Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines): Rules and standards for behavior across Discord services.
- [Safety Center](https://discord.com/safety): Overview of Discord’s trust, safety, and reporting resources.
- [Policy Hub](https://discord.com/safety-policies): Directory of policy-related resources and safety documentation.

## Advertising
- [Discord Quests Advertising](https://discord.com/ads/quests): Overview of Discord’s Quests advertising product for brands and campaigns.
- [Quests Success Stories](https://discord.com/ads/quests-success-stories): Case studies and examples of campaign outcomes using Quests.
- [Quests FAQ](https://discord.com/ads/quests-faq): Frequently asked questions about Quests advertising capabilities and operations.

## Community and Discovery
- [Servers Directory](https://discord.com/servers): Browse and discover public Discord communities by interest.
- [Blog](https://discord.com/blog): Stories, launches, and updates from the Discord team.
- [Download](https://discord.com/download): Install Discord to join communities across desktop and mobile.
- [Nitro](https://discord.com/nitro): Premium features for enhanced expression, streaming, and customization.

## Account and App Help
- [Support Home](https://support.discord.com/hc): Starting point for account, billing, and technical support articles.
- [Requests](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit support tickets for help with Discord services.
- [Feedback Topics](https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/community/topics): Browse feature requests and community-submitted feedback.
- [Discord Status](https://discordstatus.com/): Check current operational status before troubleshooting app issues.
